decisions.reason: Its repeated home-page placement suggests performance at or above aspiration for an extension of the core messaging business, and in a growing, hiring firm the product merits continued support.
A dedicated page plus a named customer success signal validated market acceptance in digital document workflows, so it likely exceeds aspiration and fits the firm's strategic direction.
Although evidence is modest, it remained offered and closely leverages the firm's multichannel messaging base, so with organizational slack and regulated customer demand it is worth retaining.
As a close-in fax optimization feature, it likely requires limited extra resources while strengthening the installed base for customers still dependent on reliable fax delivery.

Security is central to the firm's value proposition and this threat-protection offer stayed in the portfolio, so management would keep it as a strategically important complement unless results clearly fell below aspiration.
